# png2asset invocation args — port vs reference grep + 4-variant isolation experiment

## 1. Autogenerated 'Conversion args:' comment from each generated file

### Port: gbkt-examples/metasprites/build/gbkt/generated/sprites/elephant.c
// Conversion args: /elephant.png -o /elephant.c -spr8x8

### Reference: /Users/michalsvacha/gbdk/examples/cross-platform/metasprites/obj/gb/res/sprite.c
// Conversion args: /sprite.png -sh 48 -spr8x8 -noflip -c /sprite.c

Character-by-character arg diff (after the input PNG path):
  Port:      -o /elephant.c -spr8x8
  Reference: -sh 48 -spr8x8 -noflip -o /sprite.c   (Makefile invocation)

Port-side gradle task source (ConvertSpritesTask.kt lines 199-205):
```kotlin
val args = mutableListOf(pngFile.absolutePath, "-o", outputC.absolutePath)
when (spriteMode) {
    SpriteMode.SPR8x8 -> args.add("-spr8x8")
    SpriteMode.SPR8x16 -> { /* default, no flag needed */ }
}
```

=> Port omits BOTH -sh AND -noflip. Reference uses both.

## 2. Isolation experiment — which flag is the discriminator?

Ran png2asset 4 times on gbkt-examples/metasprites/res/sprites/elephant.png
(md5: ecd8079c82760223213cd14aa3f4b1a1; identical to reference PNG md5).

| Variant | Args                              | tile-array size | METASPR_ITEM attrs used |
|---------|-----------------------------------|-----------------|--------------------------|
| A (ref) | `-sh 48 -spr8x8 -noflip`          | [768] = 48 tiles | S_PAL(0) only           |
| B (port)| `-spr8x8`                         | [720] = 45 tiles | S_PAL(0) + S_FLIPX      |
| C       | `-spr8x8 -noflip` (no -sh)        | [768] = 48 tiles | S_PAL(0) only           |
| D       | `-sh 48 -spr8x8` (no -noflip)     | [720] = 45 tiles | S_PAL(0) + S_FLIPX      |

Discriminator isolated: `-noflip`. `-sh 48` is irrelevant to tile count.

Without `-noflip`, png2asset detects mirror tiles, emits ONE tile + a flip-bit
S_FLIPX entry in the METASPR_ITEM table, and renumbers the dense tile-data array.
With `-noflip`, the flip detection is disabled -- every input tile becomes a
unique entry in the tile-data array, preserving the reference's tile-id contract.

## 3. First METASPR_ITEM entry comparison

Variant A (ref-equivalent, -noflip ON):
	METASPR_ITEM(-16, -24, 0, S_PAL(0)),
Variant B (port-equivalent, -noflip OFF):
	METASPR_ITEM(-112, -24, 0, S_PAL(0)),

Note: even the dy offset differs (-16 vs -112), confirming png2asset's
auto-generated METASPR table is incompatible between the two modes -- not
just tile-ids. The port DSL doesn't consume png2asset's METASPR table, but
this still demonstrates the two invocations are not behavior-equivalent.

## 4. Max-baseId comparison (the 3-tile gap)

Variant A (ref): max METASPR_ITEM dtile = 47  (48 distinct tiles 0..47)
Variant B (port): max METASPR_ITEM dtile = 44 (45 distinct tiles 0..44)

The 3-tile gap (47 - 44) IS the 3 missing tiles' worth of pixel content
the user observed in the UAT screenshot.
